Your beginning

Warm hands

You begin an adult life with one small gift: your hands run warm enough to revive cold bread, at the price of your own stamina.

Cold kitchen

Your opening: A cold kitchen with six day-old loaves. Your hands have always run warm; you have never made anything of it.

Warm a cold loaf in your palms · stamina

Hold a cold loaf until it is warm. The heat is your own, so it costs stamina, and your hands need a short rest between warmings. Practice lowers the stamina price and, once your hands are steady, lets you warm a whole batch.

With steady hands, warm three cold loaves in one go for the heat of about two single warmings. The same rest applies afterward.
